newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Most soymeal basis offers flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Most soymeal basis offers flat.

text.p: Most soymeal basis offers in cash markets were unchanged Wednesday in lackluster dealings, cash sources said.
"The domestic market is very quiet," said one southeastern broker. "If the market drops below $270.00 (CBOT, per ton), then they'll (end-users) come back in and do some business."
Basis levels were supported by talk of some U.S. crushers temporarily shutting down.
This week, a crusher in southern Minnesota and a crusher in north central Iowa are said to be taking downtime, dealers said.
U.S. soymeal export markets are very quiet. Cash and futures markets have been filled with rumors that China has recently bought up to 500,000 tonnes of Brazilian soymeal.
However, traders in Brazil said that although the Chinese buying was likely, actual trades were much smaller in quantity than those rumored in the U.S.
